newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Ocean Diamond tops trading.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Ocean Diamond tops trading.

text.p: Heavy trading in Ocean Diamond Mining which saw 510,000 shares changing hand dominated trading on the Namibian Stock Exchange (NSE) last week, dealers said.
Following on its heels was CIC Holdings where 150,100 shares were traded, they said. Southern Life Association continued active with N$2.8 million worth of shares bought and sold.
During the week a total of 838,100 shares worth N$7.7 million changed hands.
The NSE overall index ended the week at 241,29 rising from 236.29 the previous week. The NSE local index was virtually unchanged at 154.37 compard to 154.34 a week before.
